race.comment: NOTHINGELSEMATTERS (9) was shuffled back mid-race then regathered to score a game win under 60kgs over 2000m at Mornington last start. Has a strong 2200m record and was competitive in open company two back. Nice chance down in the weights. CABLE DANCER (10) settled back in the field and made late inroads to finish less than two lengths from NOTHINGELSEMATTERS at Mornington last weekend. Fitter for three runs back, in the money at all six runs over 2200m, and the blinkers go on. Triple tick. UNSEEN RULER (7) has not landed a blow in two runs this time in work. Needs this trip and drops sharply in the weights so look for a much better run. RAGING BULL (4) was a brave winner two back over this distance at Hamilton then didn't do a bad job in the Bendigo Cup more recently. This looks a nice race for him. AFTERMATH (1) is racing in great heart and must be respected despite giving weight to all his rivals.
